_about: Standalone tools (A9 tools track). A tool stands on a line where its centre meets it: its `mount` side (the foot, middle of that edge) rests against a drawn line it takes (`mounts`: pipe, cable, network, strut) and is bolted there, and `front` (opposite the mount) is the side it works on. `needs: ['line']` makes a tool short of its line do nothing and say so. See machines/tools/mount.gd. Prices are placeholders until A10. See logistics.json for the format.

modules.name: Area Vac
modules.blurb: Stands on a Pipe, its top against the pipe, and draws every loose pixel (powder, liquid, gas) of a wide patch under it into the Pipe, nearest row first, for a little power a cell. The Pipe carries them to its far base. The Vacuum does this into its own base; the Area Vac reaches wherever a Pipe runs.

modules.name: Scoop
modules.blurb: Stands on a Pipe, its top against the pipe, and lifts a measured scoop of one powder or liquid out of the small spot under it into the Pipe. It picks the most plentiful material there and keeps to it until none is left.

modules.name: Grabber
modules.blurb: Stands on a line (a Strut, Pipe, Cable or Network line), its top against it, and takes hold of a loose rigid body that comes between its jaws. It carries the body wherever its line is carried until a click lets go. A click steps grab, hold, off. A grab costs a little power.

modules.name: Floodlight
modules.blurb: Stands on a line and lights a pool 300 cells wide round it for 0.15 power/s, wherever a line can carry it into a Node's or the Hub's reach. The Lamp stays as the plain fixed light.
